text:
Andrei Svechnikov has 11 goals and 21 points in 21 games, with a four-game point streak that included two goals against Seattle in Helsinki. NDTV Sports has him on pace for a career-best season, and nothing in our numbers says it's a mirage.

He's getting the chances. His own expected goals sit at 1.59 per 60, and his 11 goals came on 9.8 expected, a modest gap with no luck flag attached. Carolina takes 61% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice. He also has 45 hits, which is part of his game the box score shows clearly.

The interesting contrast is last season. Evolving-Hockey had him at only 0.4 wins above replacement, but 1.5 expected wins, built from chance quality: the chances were there, the finishing wasn't. This season the finishing has shown up. Evolving-Hockey also noted strong teammates and a defensive cost (opponents got 0.17 more expected goals per 60 with him on). Watch his minutes, 17.6 a night. If Carolina gives him more, our range of 28 to 43 goals has room at the top.
headline: Svechnikov is finishing what he starts
